defect: Authorized commands/entities/fluids omitted from initial login command packet before playersByUUID insertion. Real Fabric user confirmed console deop/op while connected restored them.
fix: Command-node visibility uses current permission only. Execution and deferred results retain current connected identity checks; command history validates before query dispatch.
nativeSourceVerification: Fabric and NeoForge PlayerList.placeNewPlayer call sendPlayerPermissionLevel, which invokes Commands.sendCommands, before playersByUUID.put.
